sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
ORAFOL develops and produces self-adhesive graphic products, reflective materials, and industrial adhesive tapes with a focus on premium quality and high-tech polymer solutions.

Industry: Polymer production and finishing · HQ: Oranienburg, Germany · Size: 1000-4999 · Products: Self-adhesive graphic products, Reflective materials, Industrial adhesive tapes, Digital printing films, ORAJET® XP3971RA+ ProSlide

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: ORAFOL Europe scores 29 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 100% confidence. The score is carried by company size (12/15). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: No close match to a reference account. This lead stands on its own ICP fit rather than on resemblance to a known win.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body: • Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
